rows.note: Use 插手 as the all-purpose colloquial choice when you mean meddling in someone else’s affairs.

example.english: I don't want to interfere in the matter between you two brothers.
example.traditional: 你哋兩兄弟嘅事，我唔想插手。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 ge3 si6 ngo5 m4 soeng2 caap3 sau2

rows.note: Use 干涉 as a broader alternative for meddling, and as the technical term when waves affect one another.

example.english: When two sound waves overlap, they interfere with each other.
example.traditional: 兩列聲波重疊時會互相干涉。
example.jyutping: loeng5 lit6 sing1 bo1 cung4 dip6 si4 wui6 wu6 soeng1 gon1 sip3

rows.note: Use 非禮 when interfere means sexually molest, especially in reference to a child.

example.english: The police arrested that man because he would interfere with children in a sexual way.
example.traditional: 嗰個男人成日非禮啲細路，所以畀警察拉咗。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan2 sing4 jat6 fei1 lai5 di1 sai3 lou6 so2 ji5 bei2 ging2 caat3 laai1 zo2
